title: Analyst - AML & KYC
jobDescription:
We are seeking a detail-oriented KYC/KYB & Fraud Analyst with 2+ years of experience in AML, financial crime, fraud investigations, and customer due diligence. The role involves conducting KYC/KYB reviews, CDD/EDD checks, UBO verification, PEP and sanctions screening, fraud investigations, risk assessments, and adverse media reviews. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and communication skills, a solid understanding of AML/KYC regulations, and experience working in banking, fintech, or financial services environments.

We are seeking a detail-oriented KYC/KYB & Fraud Analyst with 2+ years of experience in AML, financial crime, fraud investigations, and customer due diligence. The role involves conducting KYC/KYB reviews, CDD/EDD checks, UBO verification, PEP and sanctions screening, fraud investigations, risk assessments, and adverse media reviews. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and communication skills, a solid understanding of AML/KYC regulations, and experience working in banking, fintech, or financial services environments. Key Responsibilities: Conduct end-to-end KYC/KYB reviews for individuals or business entities, including Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) verification, and PEP/Sanctions screening. Collect, review and validate customer documentation, business registrations, ownership structures, financial records, and digital footprints to assess authenticity and risk. Perform KYC fraud investigations by identifying suspicious activities, high-risk customers, account takeovers, impersonation, first-party fraud, chargebacks, and other fraud typologies related to KYC/KYB checks. Utilize internal and external databases, public records, and online sources to conduct background checks, risk assessments, and adverse media reviews. Identify and escalate suspicious activities, compliance concerns, or potential fraud exposure to Compliance, Risk, and Fraud teams. Communicate effectively with peers, managers, subject matter experts, and other internal stakeholders to address queries, provide guidance, escalate issues, and draft responses that meet regulatory standards. Maintain accurate investigation records, audit trails, and case documentation in accordance with AML, KYC, and fraud prevention policies. Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, Product, Customer Success, and QA teams to support risk mitigation, process improvements, and regulatory compliance initiatives. Stay updated on AML/KYC regulations, sanctions requirements, and industry best practices. Rigorously uphold data privacy and confidentiality standards in all aspects of sensitive customer information handling and record-keeping. Required Skills & Experience: Bachelor's degree in finance, Business, Law, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in KYC/KYB, AML Compliance, Fraud Investigations, Financial Crime Operations, or FinTech/Banking environments. Strong knowledge of KYC/KYB processes, CDD, EDD, UBO verification, PEP screening, sanctions screening, and AML regulations. Excellent analytical, investigative, documentation, and risk assessment skills with strong attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage customers and cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet SLAs, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in MS Office Suite and relevant compliance/risk management tools. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, or ACAMS are preferred but not mandatory. Preferred / Additional Skills: Previous experience in Banks/SBFE, fintech, payments, or financial services. Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt to fast-paced environments. Exposure to digital research, OSINT (Open-source intelligence), and large corporate customer profiles. Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in related fields like accounting, economics, business management, statistics, etc.

title: Analyst - Collections Analytics
jobDescription:
Collections Specialist will play a key role in optimizing collections strategies across the telecom debt lifecycle by analyzing existing collections populations to uncover behavioral patterns, segment-level trends, and strategic gaps. This role will leverage risk analysis to build, monitor, and continuously improve existing collections strategies that drive smarter prioritization and treatment of delinquent accounts. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills in SQL, Python/R, and MS Excel with a solid understanding of collections and credit risk concepts to deliver smart strategies and actionable insights.

Collections Specialist will play a key role in optimizing collections strategies across the telecom debt lifecycle by analyzing existing collections populations to uncover behavioral patterns, segment-level trends, and strategic gaps. This role will leverage risk analysis to build, monitor, and continuously improve existing collections strategies that drive smarter prioritization and treatment of delinquent accounts. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills in SQL, Python/R, and MS Excel with a solid understanding of collections and credit risk concepts to deliver smart strategies and actionable insights. Key Responsibilities: End-to-End Analysis: Conduct analysis of all collections activities, including outreach (email, phone, portal messages), payment arrangement negotiations, settlement discussions, chargeback resolution, and escalations. Risk Analysis: Assess portfolio exposure and borrower/subscriber risk profiles. Evaluate the effectiveness of various collections interventions across different customer segments. Predictive Modeling: Apply machine learning techniques and perform feature engineering to build and refine predictive models. These models are used for risk segmentation, prioritization, and treatment strategies for delinquent accounts. Model Maintenance: Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve existing collections models by tracking performance metrics and recalibrating them to maintain accuracy. Reporting & Insights: Design and deliver ongoing reporting and dashboards that translate model outputs and performance into actionable insights for stakeholders. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with payments, recoveries, analytics teams, and senior leadership for ad-hoc analyses and data-informed decision-making. Fraud & Dispute Investigation: Investigate disputed card transactions, First-Party and Third-Party chargebacks, suspected fraud, or Account Takeover (ATO) issues, coordinating with Fraud/Credit Abuse teams. Verification & Research: Execute skip-tracing, business entity and cardholder verification, and research corporate ownership/contact information using internal systems, public records, and third-party applications. KPI & SLA Reporting: Report on specific Collections KPIs and SLAs, including cure rate, recovery rate, promise-to-pay rate, right-party contact (RPC) rate, and contribute to overall process improvements. Required Skills & Qualifications: Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Finance, or a related field is preferred. Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in data science or analytics. Ideal backgrounds include collections, credit risk, telecom, or financial services. Programming/Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SQL. Proficiency in a programming language like Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and model development. Proficiency in MS Excel, specifically using pivot tables and complex formulas for reporting. Machine Learning: Hands-on experience with techniques such as logistic regression, decision trees, gradient boosting, and clustering. Experience with feature engineering for predictive modeling is also required. Statistics & Risk Analysis: Solid grounding in statistics and risk analysis, including model validation and performance monitoring (using metrics like KS, AUC, PSI), and score and model recalibration. Data Handling: Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data cleaning, wrangling, and pipeline development. Preferred Attributes: Domain Knowledge: Experience with collections or credit risk strategy concepts, such as delinquency buckets, roll rates, propensity-to-pay models, and treatment/segmentation strategies. Additional Methodologies: Knowledge of uplift modeling and A/B testing. Tools: Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau is a plus. Certifications: Certifications in collections, credit management, or card operations compliance are considered an asset.

title: Analyst - Collections Specialist
jobDescription:
Collections Specialist is responsible for managing and recovering outstanding receivables across business customers, commercial borrowers, and corporate/charge card accounts. This role requires strong verbal and written communication, solid negotiation skills, familiarity with US collections laws and commercial lending and charge-card practices, and the ability to manage a diverse portfolio of accounts to minimize credit loss while preserving customer relationships.

Collections Specialist is responsible for managing and recovering outstanding receivables across business customers, commercial borrowers, and corporate/charge card accounts. This role requires strong verbal and written communication, solid negotiation skills, familiarity with US collections laws and commercial lending and charge-card practices, and the ability to manage a diverse portfolio of accounts to minimize credit loss while preserving customer relationships. Key Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of commercial accounts, business entity receivables, charge/corporate card accounts, and commercial loans. Conduct end-to-end collections activities: outreach (email, phone, portal messages), negotiation of payment arrangements, settlement discussions, chargeback resolution, and escalation when necessary. Review account histories, cardholder agreements, merchant statements, invoices, credit agreements, and payment records to determine obligations and appropriate collection strategies. Prepare and send professional collection correspondence and payment demand notices; draft clear, grammatically correct emails and letters to customers, cardholders, internal stakeholders, and external counsel. Investigate disputed card transactions, First-Party and Third-Party chargebacks, suspected fraud or ATO issues, and coordinate with Fraud/Operations teams. Coordinate with underwriting, billing, credit, legal, card operations, and account management teams on disputed balances, reconciliations, workout plans, and UCC filings. Execute skip-tracing, business entity and cardholder verification, and research into corporate ownership and contact information using internal systems, public records and third party applications. Maintain accurate case notes, payment plans, reconciliations, and documentation in the collections system to ensure auditability and compliance. Escalate high-risk or legally sensitive accounts to Legal or Senior Collections for recovery actions, litigation referral, charge-off recommendations, or card program enforcement (suspensions, account closures). Monitor and comply with US federal and state collections laws and regulations (including FDCPA where applicable, Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), State statutes of limitation), and card network rules (Visa, Mastercard) and issuer program policies. Meet or exceed collections KPIs and SLAs (recovery rate, promise-to-pay adherence, call/contact quotas), and contribute to process improvements. Required Skills & Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's degree in finance, Business, Accounting, or related field preferred. Experience: 3+ years of collections experience in banking, B2B accounts receivable, commercial lending, card programs, payments or fintech. Portfolio Management: Experience handling charge/corporate card portfolios, chargebacks, and merchant/cardholder dispute workflows. Industry Knowledge: Strong knowledge of commercial collections practices, billing/invoicing, payment terms, settlements, and workout strategies. Compliance: Familiarity with US collections laws and card network rules and an ability to apply them practically in collections activities. Verbal Communication: Excellent verbal communication and negotiation skills; comfortable with difficult conversations with business customers, cardholders, and decision-makers. Written Communication: Strong written communication with excellent grammar and ability to produce professional emails, demand letters, and internal reports. Analytical Skills: Solid analytical and problem-solving skills; attention to detail in documentation, reconciliations, and case management. Operational Efficiency: Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities, meet SLAs, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment. Technical Proficiency: Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Outlook) and collections/accounting/card operations systems (ERP, CRM, or specialized collections software). Preferred Attributes: Specialized Experience: Experience with commercial lending portfolios, UCC filings, or coordinating with legal teams on recoveries. Industry Background: Prior experience in banks, card issuers, payment processors, or fintech environments. Research Tools: Exposure to skip-trace tools, public records research, and business entity databases. Certifications: Certifications in collections, credit management, or card operations compliance are a plus.

title: Analyst - Credit Analyst
jobDescription:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Analyst / Sr. Analyst – Credit Analyst to support underwriting operations for commercial lending and merchant acquiring portfolios. The role involves analyzing financial statements, bank statements, tax returns, and other financial documents to assess the creditworthiness of businesses and support underwriting decisions. The ideal candidate should possess strong financial analysis skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, process-driven environment while maintaining high quality and productivity standards.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Analyst / Sr. Analyst – Credit Analyst to support underwriting operations for commercial lending and merchant acquiring portfolios. The role involves analyzing financial statements, bank statements, tax returns, and other financial documents to assess the creditworthiness of businesses and support underwriting decisions. The ideal candidate should possess strong financial analysis skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, process-driven environment while maintaining high quality and productivity standards. Key Responsibilities: Perform comprehensive credit analysis by reviewing Balance Sheets, Income Statements, Cash Flow Statements, Bank Statements, and Tax Returns to assess the financial health and creditworthiness of business entities. Extract financial data accurately into underwriting templates and financial spreading tools while ensuring data completeness and consistency. Conduct ratio analysis, trend analysis, cash flow analysis, liquidity assessment, leverage analysis, and profitability evaluation to identify financial strengths and potential credit risks. Research companies using public sources to validate business operations, industry information, ownership structure, and other relevant underwriting data. Prepare MIS reports, productivity trackers, quality reports, and operational dashboards to monitor team performance and process efficiency. Identify financial risks, data discrepancies, missing information, and documentation gaps, and escalate observations to underwriting teams for further review. Review merchant risk indicators and high-risk business categories to support account enablement decisions. Utilize risk and operational platforms to perform underwriting reviews, document verification, compliance checks, and case management. Monitor underwriting queues to identify system exceptions, missing applications, and workflow discrepancies, escalating issues to relevant stakeholders. Maintain accurate application records and ensure all underwriting activities comply with internal policies, risk frameworks, and audit requirements. Required Skills & Qualifications: Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and commercial credit risk assessment. Experience reviewing bank statements, identifying transaction trends, overdrafts, NSF activities, and unusual financial transactions. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, conditional formatting, data validation, and financial calculations. Ability to manage multiple underwriting cases while consistently meeting Turnaround Time (TAT), productivity, and quality targets. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present financial observations clearly. Strong knowledge of underwriting guidelines, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), internal controls, and compliance requirements. Preferred Attributes: 1–3 years of experience in Credit Underwriting, Financial Statement Analysis, Financial Spreading, Commercial Lending, Banking, Risk Operations, or FinTech. Experience with commercial lending or SME underwriting is preferred. Exposure to financial spreading tools such as MS Excel or similar platforms is an added advantage. Familiarity with US financial statements and underwriting processes is preferred.

title: Analyst - Operations Analyst
jobDescription:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical professional to join bluCognition as a Bank Statement Analyst. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting credit decision-making for our US business lending portfolio by accurately reviewing, categorizing, and processing bank statement transactions. Your work will help build the foundation for reliable financial analysis and risk assessment, directly contributing to our clients' lending decisions. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of banking and financial data, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and a keen eye for detail. If you enjoy working with large datasets, are proficient in Microsoft Excel, and thrive in a fast-paced, quality-driven environment, this is an excellent opportunity to build your career in financial risk and analytics while working alongside experienced professionals in an AI/ML-driven organization. Key Responsibilities: Perform financial statements spreading by accurately extracting financial data from Balance Sheets, Income Statements, and Cash Flow Statements into standardized underwriting templates and financial spreading tools. Analyze audited, unaudited, consolidated, and standalone financial statements to assess the financial health and creditworthiness of business entities. Analyze debit and credit transactions from business bank statements and accurately categorize transaction data into standardized bank statement spreading templates to support financial analysis and credit underwriting decisions. Review account activity to identify cash inflows, cash outflows, recurring transactions, and business operating trends. Evaluate average monthly balances, ending balances, deposit trends, withdrawal patterns, and account utilization to assess business stability and financial performance. Categorize banking transactions into predefined business and expense categories in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Identify irregular transactions, overdrafts, NSF (Non-Sufficient Funds) activities, returned payments, and unusual banking patterns that may impact credit risk. Utilize Microsoft Excel and financial spreading tools to analyze financial data, generate reports, and maintain operational trackers. Prepare MIS reports, operational trackers, and productivity dashboards to monitor workflow, performance, and operational efficiency. Required Skills & Qualifications: Minimum bachelor's qualification in B. Com, BA, B.Sc. or related field; MBA/M. Com with understanding of finance preferred. Thorough understanding of the functions and diverse features of MS Office applications such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc. Expertise and comfort with extracting, transforming, and deriving insights from data. Analytical rigor with the ability to work in unstructured environments with clarity of thought. Solid understanding of Financial Statements with the ability to derive an entity's financial standpoint from a Credit Risk perspective. Financial services experience (Banks, Fintech, etc.) is preferred, but not mandatory. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare presentations for executive-level audiences. Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Open to flexible working hours. 0 to 3 years of relevant experience.
